final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.trdref) as distinct_count FROM transactionrecord tr JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(distinct_count) as total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.tradekind, step1.distinct_count, CAST(step1.distinct_count AS REAL) / step2.total_count as proportion FROM step1, step2), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(distinct_count) as avg_count FROM step3) SELECT step3.tradekind, step3.distinct_count, step3.proportion, step3.distinct_count - step4.avg_count FROM step3, step4 WHERE step3.distinct_count > step4.avg_count
